methods.name: artifact pyramid decoding (APD)
methods.description: A design inspired by the feature pyramid network (FPN) used for merging artifact code and content code during the decoding of an artifact-affected image.

methods.name: ADN
methods.description: A model that learns to output four intended images through various loss functions including adversarial losses, artifact consistency loss, reconstruction loss, and self-reduction loss.

methods.name: artifact consistency loss
methods.description: Loss function based on the observation that the difference between xa and ˆx and the difference between ˆya and y should be close due to the use of the same artifact.

methods.name: self-reduction mechanism
methods.description: Introduces a process where artifacts are added to y to create ˆya and then removed from ˆya to result in ˜y, used to regularize the artifact reduction.
